output.reason: [ev-25015016b295] says Flux 2.7.0 makes Kubernetes 1.32 the minimum supported version, and the release's compatibility table [ev-f88a947c0d4c] gives the requirement as ">= 1.32.0". So the exposed environments are clusters running Kubernetes below 1.32.0. The proposed condition, cluster-version kubernetes out-of-range ">=1.32.0", expresses exactly that and matches the standard form for a changed compatibility requirement. Only the exposure condition was checked here; whether older clusters actually fail is not settled by this evidence.
